errors.title: Subprocess timeout (fierce-critic)
errors.detail: The fierce-critic subprocess exceeded the timeout threshold and was terminated. This is expected behavior — a machine reader would also stop processing here. Elapsed: 120077ms. Kill reason: hard-timeout.
suggestions: Review the subprocess output for deadlocks or resource exhaustion.
Check if the target URL has changed or is now unreachable.
Consider adjusting the timeout threshold via MX_AUDIT_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS.
